title: The only truly helpful app for ADHDers
body:
You’re saving my life. I’d been literally falling apart till I found your app. Since then my life has changed hugely. I can’t say thank you enough : )


UPD: The app is super unreliable. When it works properly, it’s absolutely amazing.

But I’m freaking out when I need to do dances around a fire just to make it produce sound notifications!!!!
	1.	The app constantly asks for allowing notifications when I start a routine, but when you open the settings, there’s no such option there.
	2.	The app decides on its own whether to produce sound notifications. Some days it does, and some days it’s just “not in the mood.” And no matter what I do, it just doesn’t.

The whole point of this app is to tell me directly in my ear that it’s time to finish one thing and start the next, overcoming any other notifications or silent mode I have.

I wanted to add the app to the exclusions so I always receive notifications from it, but there is no such option for this particular app.

Whether sound notifications are produced or not doesn’t depend on the iPhone’s silent mode either. (Most of the time it works perfectly in silent mode, which I have on 99% of the time. But sometimes it doesn’t)

Sometimes I listen to an audiobook and the notifications go through to my headphones properly. Sometimes they don’t.

I would honestly switch to something more reliable, but I can’t find anything as convenient as this app. I don’t usually create routines - I create my entire next day in the app in the evening and then live my whole day with it. That was my way of beating procrastination: the app constantly tells me what I should do now and what I should do next.

So please, fix the notifications!

title: Lifesaver for my ADHD
body:
I love this app. I have tried so many other habit tracker/to-do apps and none have come close to managing my adhd symptoms like this one does. A timed to-do list is great for managing time blindness and forgetfulness. It’s helping me to keep a strict routine that betters my health and makes life more manageable for me!! 

The best part is I can pair it with my Apple Watch so that I can put my phone down and not tempt myself to get distracted scrolling or online shopping. It also pairs well with my iPad, which I’ve set up on my desk so that I can physically see the pomodoro-style timer for work tasks!!

My suggestions: 

The AI suggestions for routine items are amazing. I wish that they would add more variety of work tasks to the mix though, and that the “suggested tasks” would be more specific to the tasks I’ve already added to the routine. Sometimes, the suggested tasks are already in the routine! 

I also wish that there was a feature where you could “unroll” the routines into one big, timed task list, where you can see everything that needs to be done for that day. 

 I’m a very visual person so the running list would be really cool and helpful! 

I also think it would be helpful if we could schedule individual tasks to show up in the running task list at various intervals (I.e weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). I don’t want to have to make a “bi-weekly cleaning routine”; I want those tasks to show up automatically on the days that I have to complete them.

I think that a running task list with the ability to schedule certain tasks to show up periodically would really help me and it would be an amazing feature to add to the app! :) 

Tl;dr: Overall, this app is seriously changing my life. I can’t tell you how helpful it is for me. I’ve recommended it to my therapist to share with her adhd patients as well!

title: Great app for ADHD - couple adjustments needed
body:
Here’s what I like:

- Less clutter than other apps like this which helps you stay focused. 

- I love the emoji’s they are better than the apple ones for sure! They could learn from you. 

- The audio reminder of a persons voice saying it’s time for the next task is really helpful and not alarming. 

- The inspirational quotes in the top of the screen. 

- The little encouragements the app gives you. Super important for RSD with ADHD. 

- You can pause and add more time to a task. 

What I’d like to see changed/added:

- “Timer start screen settings” is UNRESPONSIVE AT ALL TIMES 
 
- More musical tones to choose from for reminders to start new tasks please 

- Be able to add emojis from app ( which are awesome 😎) to sub routines in context section. ( My context here is that it allows a shortcut for my brain to know what I’m doing next without being overwhelmed by words )

- Be able to auto select “move task to end” as the response when I want to skip. - especially helpful for when making new habits and finding what works and what doesn’t. This automated section instead of having to select away from “skip today” doesn’t give me an out to cheat the routine and actually complete it and it doesn’t feel like I’m failing either. 

Overall a wonderful app! I have tried dozens of apps and this one works. Thank you. I look forward to your new additions!

author: Auroramartinezz

title: Really worth it! 1-2 bugs
body:
I love this app, as an ADHDer I have a hard time sticking to routines and this app has actually kept my interest/motivation for months now :) It’s exactly what I need to get me going in the mornings, to simplify the decision making process and keep me moving from task to task. A couple of issues though, which I’d love to see fixed!

- the main one is that it is SO SLOW and glitchy. If you try to check off/skip more than one task within 10 seconds, it freezes for at least that amount of time. Also uses a HUGE chunk of my battery which is an issue especially in the mornings when I find myself leaving for work with my phone at 60-70% (down from 100%) after doing a 1hr routine. No reason in the world that a simple habit tracker should require so much power to run in the background!! Please fix!

- I would love the ability to change the order and add/skip events while you’re in a routine. It only gives you the option to rearrange one list item at a time, when you’re currently supposed to be doing that item. Especially since the app is slow, this takes way too long if I want to check off a later task during the routine I have to skip every single task before it, in order, while waiting for it to stop freezing up. Torture.

- a feature I’d love to see: setting an end time for the routine. Eg. I want to say “finish this routine by 8:55am” and have it remind me what time to start the routine. Maybe even condense the list items if I’m running behind, like automatically reducing the “breakfast” item from 15 minutes to 12 minutes if I’m running late. I love this app but it still doesn’t quite get me out the door on time since there is far too much flexibility to pause or go over the time limits… 🙄 lol

Overall I think it’s still worth using!! After less than a week I splurged and paid for the full version and I still don’t regret it, this is one of the ones I could immediately tell would be worth it. Genius concept and thank you so much for designing this ❤️
